assessment: A-level tool-first page for "robots.txt checker" (1300/mo, KD 35): the Robots.txt Tester is the first screen, the 48-word answer resolves the query directly, and the body answers "robots.txt tester", "robots.txt validator" with first-hand AEOeye measurements before handing off to the free SEO audit.

topic.readerProblem: Someone searching "robots.txt checker" wants to run the check immediately and know what the result means for their site.
topic.connection: The free SEO audit runs this check site-wide (crawlability, on-page, speed, schema, HTTPS); this page is the single-URL version and links into it.

sources.supports: Robots.txt spec: 500 KiB limit, 4xx = no restrictions, 5xx = stop 12h then last good copy up to 30 days, least restrictive rule wins, crawl-delay unsupported, 24h cache.
Robots Exclusion Protocol: most specific user-agent group and longest-match rules.
AEOeye 391-site robots.txt study: per-bot block rates by group (e.g. GPTBot 9.1%, ClaudeBot 11.5%, Bytespider 14.6%).

checks: Re-read every factual claim against the cited primary sources, fetched on 2026-10-24 (3 sources listed on the page); unverifiable statements were removed or reworded before publishing.
content-lint passed with no errors: 382 words, 2 Pexels images, 2 inline source links, 3 internal links, 4 FAQs, 4 H2 sections.
Title/H1, secondary-keyword H2s and meta description match the locked three-round plan in docs/seo-v2/final-table.json.
Rendered on the local build at a 375 px mobile viewport: no horizontal overflow (document scrollWidth equals the viewport width).
Recomputed every figure quoted from AEOeye AI Crawler Access Study (391 sites, 2026-10-03) from the raw files in /public/resources.
Exercised POST /api/tools/robots against live public sites on the local build and confirmed a structured result (verdict, headline, sections) renders on the page.
